newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open up except silver.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open up except silver.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious metals futures were called to open higher except for silver as the complex awaited the over-the-counter options expiry.
COMEX August gold was called $0.50 to $1.00 above Wednesday's close of $339.00 an ounce after trading from $340.20 to $339.00 on ACCESS. In the bullion market, spot
gold was quoted at $337.85/$338.35 early against the London morning fix of $337.90 and the New York close Wednesday of $337.10/60.
COMEX September silver was called flat to off 1.00 cent.
Precious metals prices were barely changed overnight amid the dearth of news.
COMEX warehouse gold stocks were unchanged at 841,145 ounces Wednesday, while COMEX silver stocks were up 249,958 ounces at 186,663,538 ounces.
COMEX September silver traded on ACCESS between $4.815 and $4.81.
NYMEX July platinum was called up $0.50 to $1.00 from Wednedsay's finish of $411.50, with NYMEX September palladium called unchanged to $0.50 firmer after ending yesterday at $181.15.
U.S. jobless claims for week ended June 21, forecast at 340,000 compared to 347,000 in the previous week, are due at 0830 EDT.
